description: Grimentz is the wooden village of the Val d’Anniviers, with sun-darkened larch houses and granaries along Rue du Village and the white church of Saint-Théodule. The wooden spire dates from 1831, and the church body was rebuilt in 1950–51 after the 1946 earthquake. It is not the timber village of Evolène in the Val d’Hérens.
